attention_backend_rule: Only explicit cuda.py 'Using NAME attention backend' lines identify attention; FlashAttention version lines qualify it. Sampler/autotune FlashInfer lines do not.

process_cost_lower_bound.rule: One complete-or-failure terminal process elapsed interval per distinct run. Completion takes precedence if both exist. Never sum nested initialization, policy, audit, window or queue elapsed times.
process_cost_lower_bound.exclusions: Setup/download/test/export/analysis time and unrecorded shutdown overhead; not GPU-busy time or total project cost.

claim_scope: Archive integrity and retained evidence only; no new speed, accuracy, numerical acceptance or novelty claim.
